data.question: I keep building features nobody uses. Will this help me understand what clients actually need?
data.answer: Absolutely. This volume focuses specifically on understanding client needs, requirements discovery, and User-Centered Design principles. You'll learn to decode what users truly need versus what they say they want.

data.question: I don't have time to read an entire 50-page book. Can I still learn something here?
data.answer: Yes. The chapters are designed as standalone resources, allowing quick searches when facing specific problems, plus external links for deeper exploration. You can jump to exactly what you need right now.

data.question: Will this volume teach me UX design tools and technical implementation?
data.answer: This volume focuses on foundational UX principles, requirements discovery techniques, and user-centered thinking rather than specific design tools. It's about understanding the 'why' and 'what' before the 'how' of implementation.

data.question: What if I don't like it? How does the money-back guarantee work?
data.answer: Contact within 14 days for a full refund. The creator only requests feedback on unmet expectations. No hassle, no questions asked beyond understanding how to improve.

data.question: What exactly is covered in this volume?
data.answer: Volume 2 covers requirements discovery and documentation, User-Centered Design principles, Jobs-To-Be-Done theory, UX design fundamentals (research, personas, design patterns), Minimum Lovable Products, Design Sprints, and effective specifications development. Full chapter breakdowns and free samples are available on dev-concepts.dev.

data.question: Should I get the bundle instead?
data.answer: If you also want to learn about software craftsmanship and professional mindset (Volume 1), plus get lifetime Slack community access with senior developer mentorship, the Starter Bundle offers better value.

data.question: Will there be more volumes?
data.answer: Yes, this is part of a planned 12-volume series covering comprehensive software development topics. New volumes release every few months. Consider the Lifetime Bundle on dev-concepts.dev to get all volumes as they're released.

data.question: I can't afford to buy this...
data.answer: Contact the author via Twitter or email to discuss options. Sébastien wants to help developers grow regardless of their financial situation.

data.question: I want to buy this for my team at work
data.answer: Group licenses are available; contact the author for pricing details. This is perfect for helping your team better understand client needs and build the right features.
